# Brain curation loop - PR approval in Slack

GitHub `pull_request` webhook on your brain repo filters `bot/*` PRs (the curator opens these for SENSITIVE changes) and posts an Approve / Reject card to a Slack channel.

Clicks come back through the Slack Action Webhook and squash-merge or comment-and-close the PR through the GitHub API.

Setup: docs/setup.md in the repo. Replace REPLACE_WITH_* placeholders, pick your Slack credential on the Slack node, register both webhook URLs (GitHub repo webhook, Slack app interactivity).
